summary: Short kerb by the Clarence Road junction, apartments about 11-17 m away.
reasons: Apartment block about 11-17 m from kerb

best_section.where: Railway Avenue, just before the junction with Clarence Road, beside the kindergarten

drivers.seclusion: Scribe on Clarence apartments about 11-17 m up the lane on the same side (mapped at 4 m only at the very start); kindergarten (non-residential) 4 m away; rail corridor on the other side.
drivers.access_and_room: Public lane off Clarence Road; two cars already park along the kerb, so room is tight but usable.
drivers.traffic: Beside four rail tracks and a busy road junction; noisy.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but a No Stopping Mon-Fri 7-9am sign sits at the kerb.

flags: No Stopping Mon-Fri 7-9am sign 3.5 m from the kerb line
Only about 12 m of usable kerb, short for a van
sun_shade: Apartment block shades the kerb in the morning; rail side open to the west.
cannot_judge: Exact van fit between parked cars
